description: GuardEnricher: guard, guard_defines, guard_negates, guard_mentions, guard_group_id, guard_branch. Grounded on the frozen zephyr corpus, where every case has a real ground-truth file whose raw directives were read by hand. Cases marked "expect_fail" assert the CORRECT value for a defect that is still open: they fail today by design, and the change that fixes the defect must promote them to hard in the same commit.

cases.name: simple_forms_if_arm
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'subsys/net/ip/net_private.h' WHERE guard = 'defined(CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP)' WHERE guard_defines LIKE '%CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP%' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 20

cases.name: simple_forms_else_arm
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'subsys/net/ip/net_private.h' WHERE guard = '!defined(CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP)' WHERE guard_negates LIKE '%CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP%' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 20

cases.name: nested_and_composition
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'subsys/net/ip/net_private.h' WHERE guard = 'CONFIG_NET_MGMT_EVENT_INFO && CONFIG_NET_L2_WIFI_MGMT' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 20

cases.name: branch_ordinals_first_arm
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'soc/nordic/common/gppi_init.c' WHERE guard_branch = '0' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 50

cases.name: arm_rows_share_one_guard_group
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'soc/nordic/common/gppi_init.c' WHERE guard = 'defined(CONFIG_SOC_NRF54H20_CPUAPP)' WHERE line > 15 ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 100

cases.name: known_field_with_no_carriers_is_an_empty_set
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'if' WHERE guard != '' LIMIT 5

cases.name: extern_c_minimal
cases.expect_fail_reason: the #endif closing an `#ifdef __cplusplus` / `extern "C" {` pair does not pop the guard stack, so the file's second __cplusplus group opens inside the first and its rows carry the conjunct twice
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'samples/bluetooth/peripheral_ht/src/hts.h' WHERE guard MATCHES '__cplusplus.*__cplusplus' LIMIT 10

cases.name: extern_c_header
cases.expect_fail_reason: everything after `extern "C" {` inherits a false `&& __cplusplus`; the 123 symbols between the two __cplusplus groups belong to the enclosing !_ASMLANGUAGE region, and only the two `#ifdef __cplusplus` conditions themselves are genuinely C++-only

steps.fql: FIND symbols IN 'include/zephyr/arch/arm/syscall.h' WHERE guard = '!ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ARCH_ARM_SYSCALL_H_ && CONFIG_USERSPACE && !_ASMLANGUAGE' LIMIT 300
FIND symbols IN 'include/zephyr/arch/arm/syscall.h' WHERE guard MATCHES '__cplusplus$' LIMIT 300

cases.name: elif_chain_negation
cases.expect_fail_reason: an #elif arm is reported as if it were a standalone #if: the fourth arm of the gppi chain drops the negations of the three arms before it, so guard_negates never mentions PPI_PRESENT
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'soc/nordic/common/gppi_init.c' WHERE guard_defines LIKE '%CONFIG_SOC_NRF54H20_CPUAPP%' WHERE guard_negates LIKE '%PPI_PRESENT%' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 100

cases.name: elif_parenthesis
cases.expect_fail_reason: a child condition containing a top-level || is spliced into its parent with && and no parentheses, so the emitted string parses as (A && B) || C; this row also carries the false && __cplusplus conjunct
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'include/zephyr/irq_multilevel.h' WHERE guard = '!ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_IRQ_MULTILEVEL_H_ && !_ASMLANGUAGE && (defined(CONFIG_MULTI_LEVEL_INTERRUPTS) || defined(__DOXYGEN__))' LIMIT 200

cases.name: else_demorgan
cases.expect_fail_reason: negating a disjunction does not decompose: !(A || B) is equivalent to !A && !B, so both symbols belong in guard_negates, but only guard_mentions lists them
cases.fql: FIND symbols WHERE guard = '!(defined(CONFIG_NET_NATIVE) || defined(CONFIG_NET_OFFLOAD))' WHERE guard_negates LIKE '%CONFIG_NET_NATIVE%' WHERE guard_negates LIKE '%CONFIG_NET_OFFLOAD%' LIMIT 50

cases.name: guard_whitespace_normalised
cases.expect_fail_reason: a multi-line #if keeps its backslash continuations, newlines and leading tabs verbatim, so GROUP BY guard splits identical conditions and the value cannot be written in a WHERE clause

cases.name: guard_on_expression_rows
cases.expect_fail_reason: guard fields are injected only into declaration-like rows; expression and control-flow rows never carry them, so the literal 32 on line 24 shows no guard even though it sits inside the DPPIC_PRESENT arm
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'soc/nordic/common/gppi_init.c' WHERE fql_kind = 'number' WHERE guard_defines LIKE '%DPPIC_PRESENT%' ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 5

cases.name: guard_reaches_every_row_kind_in_a_region
cases.expect_fail_reason: within one guarded region the guard reaches declaration-like rows but stops at control flow: eight rows of ticker_job_op_inquire carry the ticker-config guard and the switch on line 2989 does not, so the region reports three row kinds where it should report four
cases.fql: FIND symbols IN 'subsys/bluetooth/controller/ticker/ticker.c' WHERE guard_mentions LIKE '%CONFIG_BT_TICKER_JOB_IDLE_GET%' WHERE line >= 2975 WHERE line <= 3010 ORDER BY line ASC LIMIT 50
